Which School District 42 schools serve Silver Valley in Maple Ridge?

Public schools serving or located near Silver Valley include Yennadon Elementary (23347 128 Ave, K-7, plus the Yennadon Annex at 23310 128 Ave) and Garibaldi Secondary (24789 Dewdney Trunk Rd, 8-12). How are roads, West Coast Express access, and commuting in Silver Valley?

Primary commuter and road corridors serving Silver Valley include 232 Street, Silver Valley Road, 128 Avenue, 132 Avenue, and Abernethy Way, connecting residents to Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), Dewdney Trunk Road, the Golden Ears Bridge, and TransLink RapidBus (R3) and West Coast Express commuter rail stations.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or ALR rules apply in Silver Valley?

Silver Valley was master-planned as a sequence of eco-hamlets under the Silver Valley Area Plan (updated November 25, 2025) and Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, combining eco-cluster and hillside single-family zoning with mandatory wildfire interface, geotechnical slope, and watercourse protection Development Permit Areas.
